name: Monitor hotel competitor rates on Booking.com and tiket.com with MrScraper, Gemini and Telegram

values.content:
=Kamu analis revenue akomodasi. Data JSON di bawah adalah hasil scraping rate KOMPETITOR pada run ini.
Pembaca laporan = pengelola properti di area yang sama. Pembaca TIDAK mengelola properti di data.
Field:
- run: tanggal menginap (target_dates), rates_compared = jumlah rate yang punya harga pembanding, mode = baseline atau tracking
- alerts: perubahan level harga minimal 5% (naik atau turun) yang sudah terkonfirmasi di 2 scan berturut-turut. previous_price = level harga lama, price = level baru
- market: harga termurah per listing per target_date
- platform_health: platform yang datanya dipakai (healthy) dan yang gagal discrape (failed)
- cross_platform: properti sama di beberapa platform, harga kamar termurah tiap platform, platform termurah, selisih persen
- trends: rate yang naik atau turun beberapa hari berturut-turut (days = jumlah hari)
- date_comparison: listing sama di beberapa tanggal menginap, tanggal termurah dan termahal, selisih persen
- price_basis: excl = sebelum pajak, incl = termasuk pajak. same_basis false artinya perbandingan tidak setara
- same_room false di date_comparison: tipe kamar termurah beda antar tanggal
- sold_out: properti yang semua kamarnya penuh di platform tertentu, target_dates = tanggal penuh
- platform_health.*.status_counts: penyebab halaman tanpa harga. fetch_failed = halaman gagal diambil, llm_failed = request AI gagal (kuota habis atau server sibuk), no_price_text = halaman tanpa harga, no_room_types = kamar tidak terbaca, empty_response = scraper tidak membaca halaman, no_prices = kamar tampil tanpa harga (kemungkinan habis), sold_out_notice = halaman menampilkan pengumuman semua kamar penuh

Aturan:
- Pakai HANYA data di bawah. Jangan buat template, contoh, atau data fiktif
- Jika run.mode = baseline: tulis bahwa ini scan dasar, belum ada harga pembanding, delta muncul mulai scan berikutnya. Lewati poin 1
- Jika run.mode = tracking dan alerts kosong: tulis bahwa tidak ada perubahan harga terkonfirmasi
- Klaim harga naik atau turun HANYA dari alerts dan trends. market, cross_platform, dan date_comparison adalah beda harga antar listing, platform, atau tanggal menginap, BUKAN perubahan harga dari waktu ke waktu
- Rekomendasi untuk properti pembaca. JANGAN menyuruh kompetitor menaikkan, menurunkan, mempertahankan, atau meninjau harganya
- Tulis teks biasa untuk Telegram. Boleh pakai **tebal**. Jangan pakai tabel, heading, atau link
- Maksimal 1800 karakter
- Kalau same_basis false, tulis bahwa selisih sebagian karena pajak, jangan simpulkan sebagai selisih harga murni
- Kalau same_room false, tulis bahwa kamar termurahnya berbeda, jangan simpulkan sebagai kenaikan harga kamar yang sama

Isi pesan:
1. Maksimal 3 perubahan terbesar: nama, platform, target_date, room type, harga lama ke harga baru, persen
2. Per target_date dari market: listing dengan min_price paling rendah dan paling tinggi. Tulis bahwa angka itu harga kamar termurah listing tersebut
3. Maksimal 3 rekomendasi untuk properti pembaca. Tiap rekomendasi sebut nama kompetitor dan angka sebagai dasar
4. Kalau cross_platform tidak kosong: maksimal 2 properti, sebut platform termurah dan selisih persennya
5. Kalau trends tidak kosong: maksimal 2 tren, contoh naik 3 hari berturut-turut dari harga awal ke harga akhir
6. Kalau date_comparison tidak kosong: maksimal 3 listing, sebut tanggal termurah dan termahal serta selisih persennya
7. Kalau sold_out tidak kosong: maksimal 3 properti, sebut platform dan tanggal penuh
8. Kalimat terakhir: sebut platform di platform_health.failed dan platform dengan coverage_pct di bawah 50, beserta penyebab terbanyak dari status_counts dalam bahasa biasa

DATA:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.report) }}

parameters.prompt: =Extract each hotel or villa listing shown on this Booking.com search results page for {{ $json.area_city }}. For every listing return the hotel name, price per night in IDR, star rating if available, and the full URL to its detail page.

values.content:
=Ekstrak tipe kamar dan harga dari beberapa halaman hotel di bawah. Tiap halaman diawali "=== PAGE <id> ===". Balas HANYA JSON valid, tanpa penjelasan, tanpa markdown fence.

Format:
{"pages":[{"page_id":"p1","room_types":[{"name":"nama tipe kamar","prices":[{"price_total":"Rp 412.752","breakfast_included":false,"cancellation_policy":"teks singkat"}]}]}]}

Aturan:
- Satu entri pages untuk SETIAP halaman, page_id persis sama dengan di teks
- price_total adalah harga 1 kamar 1 malam SEBELUM pajak. Kalau ada dua angka (sebelum dan setelah pajak), pakai yang sebelum pajak
- price_total selalu diawali "Rp"
- breakfast_included true hanya kalau teks menyebut sarapan termasuk
- Jangan mengarang. Halaman tanpa harga kamar: room_types []

HALAMAN:
{{ $json.pages_text }}

parameters.content:
## Google Sheet structure
Make a copy of the [sheet template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1toPSjbY7JspOkHNheB7D3L-ezYAvjM7rBaFr8oHOdlI/copy), or create 1 Google Sheet with these 4 tabs. Row 1 = headers.

**Listings** (you fill this tab)
listing_id, nama_properti, url, platform, lokasi
- platform: Booking.com or tiket.com
- url: the property page on that platform. Rows with the same nama_properti are compared across platforms.

**Rate_History** (the workflow appends)
timestamp, run_id, listing_id, nama_properti, platform, target_date, room_type, price, previous_price, delta_pct, availability_status, breakfast_included, cancellation_policy, extraction_status, rate_key, is_new, status_changed, is_alert

**Current_Status** (the workflow upserts on rate_key)
rate_key, listing_id, nama_properti, platform, target_date, room_type, price, availability_status, last_updated

**Area_Scan** (the workflow appends)
scan_date, platform, nama_properti, price_per_night, rating, detail_url

Do not delete Rate_History rows. Alerts need at least 2 earlier scans.

## Hotel competitor rate monitor with MrScraper, Gemini and Telegram

Sign up for MrScraper [HERE](https://mrscraper.com)
Node docs: [docs.mrscraper.com](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/integrations/n8n)

This template checks competitor hotel rates on Booking.com and tiket.com every day. It saves every rate in Google Sheets and sends one Telegram report. It also reads the top listings from a Booking.com search page for the same city.

### Who's it for
Hotel, guesthouse and villa managers who want to track competitor prices without opening booking sites every day.

### How it works
1. At 15:00, **Build Requests** creates 1 URL per listing for the next 2 weekends (4 stay dates).
2. Booking.com pages go to **MrScraper Extract Booking** (Extract Structured Data, hotel category), 1 page per batch.
3. tiket.com pages go to **MrScraper Fetch Markdown** (Fetch Rendered HTML), 5 pages per batch. **Gemini Extract Rooms** reads room names and prices from the markdown.
4. **Merge Rates** joins both paths. All rows go to Rate_History and Current_Status.
5. Each rate is compared with history. An alert needs a price change of 5% or more that repeats in 2 scans in a row.
6. **MrScraper Listing Agent** reads the Booking.com search page and saves the top 5 listings to Area_Scan.
7. **Gemini Write Report** writes the summary and **Send Telegram Report** sends 1 message. If Gemini fails, the message uses a fixed format.

### How to set up
1. Self-hosted n8n: install the community node `n8n-nodes-mrscraper` (Settings > Community nodes).
2. Add credentials: MrScraper, Google Sheets OAuth2, Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Telegram.
3. Make a copy of the [sheet template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1toPSjbY7JspOkHNheB7D3L-ezYAvjM7rBaFr8oHOdlI/copy) (4 tabs, 2 sample listings). Paste its ID in the 5 Google Sheets nodes.
4. Replace the 2 sample rows in the Listings tab with your competitors.
5. Send a message to your bot, open `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates`, and copy `message.chat.id` into **Send Telegram Report**. Details: **Telegram setup** note.
6. Run once manually, then activate the workflow.

### Requirements
- MrScraper account. The Free plan allows 10 parallel requests.
- Gemini API key. 1 run uses up to 3 Gemini requests.
- Telegram bot token from @BotFather (`/newbot`).

### Customize
- Platforms and stay dates: `EXTRACTION_PATH`, `WEEKEND_COUNT` in **Build Requests**
- Alert threshold: `ALERT_THRESHOLD_PCT` in **Normalize Booking Rates** and **Normalize Markdown Rates**
- Area scan city and check-in offset: `AREA_CITY`, `DAY_OFFSET` in **Build Area Scan URL**
- Report language: the report is in Indonesian. Edit the prompt in **Gemini Write Report** and the labels in **Compose Telegram Message**

## Telegram setup
1. Create a bot: send `/newbot` to @BotFather. Put the bot token in the Telegram credential.
2. Send any message to your bot.
3. Open `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates` and copy `message.chat.id`. For a group, add the bot to the group first. A group ID starts with `-`.
4. Paste the ID in **Send Telegram Report** > Chat ID.
getUpdates returns nothing while the bot has a webhook, for example an active Telegram Trigger.
Parse Mode = HTML. 1 message per run (watchlist + area scan), max 4096 characters.

## Daily trigger
Runs every day at 15:00 in the workflow time zone. Starts the watchlist (top) and the area scan (bottom).

## 1. Load the watchlist
**Get Listings** reads the Listings tab. **Get Rate History** reads earlier scans. New prices are compared with them.

## 2. Build URLs
**Build Requests** creates 1 URL per listing per stay date (next 2 weekends). Set `EXTRACTION_PATH` and `WEEKEND_COUNT` here. Booking.com goes to the AI path, tiket.com to the markdown path.

## 3a. Booking.com: MrScraper Extract Structured Data
1 page per batch, hotel category. Returns room types, prices, breakfast and cancellation policy. **Normalize Booking Rates** compares each rate with history. A failed page is saved with its error status (On Error: Continue).

## 3b. tiket.com: MrScraper Fetch Rendered HTML
5 pages per batch, below the Free plan limit of 10 parallel requests. Home Page = on (MrScraper team advice for tiket.com). **Prepare Gemini Batches** keeps the price lines only.

## 4. Gemini room extraction
**Gemini Extract Rooms** reads room names and prices from the markdown. **Normalize Markdown Rates** maps them to each page and compares with history. **Merge Rates** joins both platforms.

## 5. Save rates
**Append Rate_History** adds every rate of this run. **Upsert Current_Status** keeps the latest price per rate_key. Do not delete Rate_History rows.

## 6. Watchlist report
**Build Report** finds alerts (a change of 5% or more in 2 scans in a row), the cheapest listing per date, and platform health. If no platform has prices, a warning replaces the report. Otherwise **Gemini Write Report** writes it (Indonesian).

## 7. Area scan: MrScraper Listing Agent
**Build Area Scan URL** searches Booking.com for `AREA_CITY`, check-in in `DAY_OFFSET` days. Listing Agent timeout = 10 min, retry off: 1 search page can take more than 5 min, and each retry starts a new MrScraper job. **Split Listings** keeps the top 5.

## 8. Listing details
**MrScraper Extract Listing** reads each listing page. **Normalize Area Listing** keeps the cheapest rate. If the detail page fails, it uses the price from the search page.

## 9. Save area scan
**Append Area_Scan** writes 1 row per listing. **Merge Area** joins this path with the no-listings path.

## 10. Message
Joins both reports into 1 HTML message (max 4096 characters). If Gemini fails, it uses a fixed format.

## 11. Send
Set your chat ID here. See the **Telegram setup** note above.
